_README: ORP per-flight data availability map. Records, per reentry flight, which gate-truth and vehicle-property data are publicly sourceable and at what fidelity. Mirrors the pattern of OpenReentry's data_availability_map.json (pinned reference at ref_core/, NOT vendored). Source tags: 'text'=stated in a report's prose/tables (directly sourceable); 'fig'=figure-only, needs digitization before use; 'lit'=in analysis/CFD literature, source carefully; 'controlled'=export/availability barrier; 'na'=not applicable. Forward-only wall: bank schedules are inputs, crossrange is an output; nothing here is a target to solve for.
_provenance_levels: Mirror orp.core.provenance.tags.ValidationLevel: NOT_VALIDATED < ASSERTED < VERIFIED_SOURCE < VERIFIED_CFD < VERIFIED_FLIGHT.

stardust_src.name: Stardust Sample Return Capsule
stardust_src.why_key: Fastest Earth entry ever (~12.9 km/s inertial / ~12.6 km/s planet-relative). Ballistic (L/D~0), spin-stabilized. Deliberate aerothermal benchmark, geometry well documented.

cg_back_from_nose_D.src: text: Mitcheltree AIAA 97-2304 (as-flown c.g.; unstable about c.p.; recommended forward to ~0.26D)

CD_hypersonic_continuum.src: text/table: Mitcheltree AIAA 97-2304 zero-AoA axial coefficient ~1.61 (continuum, M>12); full CD-vs-Mach is fig/table, partly digitizable

CD_vs_Mach.src: fig: Mitcheltree AIAA 97-2304 CFD/tunnel; decreases below M~12 (sonic-line shift); needs digitization for a full table

gate_truths._note: Reconstruction values supplied to ORP as Phase-3 inputs; treat as ASSERTED pending a pinned primary citation.

ei_latitude_deg.src: ABSENT from primary text -- swept as an assumption in the Stardust experiment

aerothermal_source.src: ABSENT from NTRS as of 2026-06-10 search; available via AIAA ARC / ResearchGate

stardust_src.primary_to_get: Desai & Qualls Stardust entry reconstruction; Mitcheltree AIAA 97-2304 (geometry, have)

artemis_i_orion.name: Artemis I (Orion) skip entry
artemis_i_orion.type: lifting blunt capsule, bank-managed skip entry
artemis_i_orion.why_key: Highest-energy crewed-class Earth return profile; lateral/skip dynamics are the Gate 3 target.

gate_truths._source: AAS 24-174, Table 1 (EI state), Table 2 (phase times), Table 3 (bank reversal times), Table 4 (splashdown), skip apogee 287.4 kft.

bank_schedule.src: fig: AAS 24-174 Fig 12(a) -- bank command, FIGURE-ONLY; reversal TIMES are in Table 3 but the initial sign is not text-locked (see convention-laundering rule)

mass_kg_range.src: text: McNamara NTRS 20140004224 (Orion design mass range)

artemis_i_orion.status: trajectory: Tables 1-4 text-sourced. heating: controlled/plot. bank command: Fig 12(a) un-digitized -> Gate 3 NOT_VALIDATED.

msl_curiosity.name: MSL (Curiosity)
msl_curiosity.why_key: Best-instrumented entry ever (MEDLI); guided, bank-managed entry. Separate population from Earth (CO2 gas).

commanded_bank_profile.src: fig/text: Mendeck & McGrew AAS 13-419 (NTRS 20130009519) -- Apollo final-phase logic; bank-angle command histories are figures, not yet digitized

reconstructed_aerodynamics.src: fig/table: Schoenenberger et al. AAS 13-306 (NTRS 20130010088) -- C_A/C_N/C_m vs Mach from IMU + heatshield pressures; figures/tables, not yet digitized

msl_curiosity.status: vehicle modeled in msl.yaml (geometry/aero ASSERTED). Bank profile + reconstructed aero remain figure-based; a Mars Gate is future work.
